---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  # renovate: datasource=conda depName=bioconda/dupblaster
  - "bioconda::dupblaster=0.3.1"

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process DUPBLASTER {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/5a/5a7fd2e4aa8b960accf56ecd8c7b66c8e53430188f95a621c95eb19a8c04915e/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/dupblaster:0.3.1--31564d2e7161cbce'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bam)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.bam"), emit: bam
    tuple val(meta), path("*.duplicate-metrics.tsv"), emit: metrics
    tuple val(meta), path("*.sequencing-units.tsv"), emit: sequencing_units, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.duplication-sampled.tsv"), emit: sampled
    tuple val(meta), path("*.duplication-spectrum.tsv"), emit: spectrum, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.pdf"), emit: pdf
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('dupblaster'), eval("dupblaster --version | sed 's/^dupblaster //'"), emit: versions_dupblaster, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    if ("${bam}" == "${prefix}.bam") {
        error("Input and output names are the same, use \"task.ext.prefix\" to disambiguate!")
    }
    """
    dupblaster \\
        --input ${bam} \\
        --output ${prefix}.bam \\
        --metrics-prefix ${prefix} \\
        ${args}
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    if ("${bam}" == "${prefix}.bam") {
        error("Input and output names are the same, use \"task.ext.prefix\" to disambiguate!")
    }
    """
    touch ${prefix}.bam
    touch ${prefix}.duplicate-metrics.tsv
    touch ${prefix}.sequencing-units.tsv
    touch ${prefix}.duplication-sampled.tsv
    touch ${prefix}.duplication-sampled.pdf
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/dupblaster"
description: "Streaming duplicate marking for NGS alignments with dupblaster; for\
  \ maximum throughput it can also run inline in the alignment pipe (aligner | dupblaster\
  \ | sort) rather than as a standalone step"
keywords:
- "duplicates"
- "markduplicates"
- "bam"
- "alignment"
tools:
- dupblaster:
    description: "Blazingly fast, streaming duplicate detection for NGS data."
    homepage: "https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/dupblaster"
    documentation: "https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/dupblaster"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/fulcrumgenomics/dupblaster"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "Query-grouped SAM/BAM (all alignments for the same read name adjacent,\n\
        e.g. straight from the aligner). Must NOT be coordinate-sorted.\n"
      pattern: "*.{bam,sam}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2573"
output:
  bam:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}.bam:
        type: "file"
        description: "BAM with duplicates marked"
        pattern: "*.bam"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  metrics:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.duplicate-metrics.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "Duplicate metrics, one row per library (TSV)"
        pattern: "*.duplicate-metrics.tsv"
        ontologies: []
  sequencing_units:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.sequencing-units.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "Duplicate metrics per flowcell and lane (TSV). Not written with\
          \ `--sequencing-duplicate-detection off`."
        pattern: "*.sequencing-units.tsv"
        ontologies: []
  sampled:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.duplication-sampled.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "Duplication rate sampled along the run (TSV)"
        pattern: "*.duplication-sampled.tsv"
        ontologies: []
  spectrum:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.duplication-spectrum.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "Histogram of how many molecules were seen how many times (TSV).\
          \ Only with `--duplication-spectrum on`."
        pattern: "*.duplication-spectrum.tsv"
        ontologies: []
  pdf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.pdf':
        type: "file"
        description: "Plots of the sampled duplication and the duplication spectrum\
          \ (PDF)"
        pattern: "*.pdf"
        ontologies: []
  versions_dupblaster:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - dupblaster:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - dupblaster --version | sed 's/^dupblaster //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - dupblaster:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - dupblaster --version | sed 's/^dupblaster //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@nh13"
maintainers:
- "@nh13"
